", "company_logo_url": "https://remotive.com/job/2091161/logo"}, {"id": 2091158, "url": "https://remotive.com/remote-jobs/software-development/software-engineer-ai-coding-tasks-2091158", "title": "Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks", "company_name": "Askable", "company_logo": "https://remotive.com/job/2091158/logo", "category": "Software Development", "tags": ["C++", "docker", "git", "go", "java", "python", "security", "AI/ML", "rust", "Typescript ", "distributed systems", "SOLID", "Linux/Unix", "testing", "infrastructure"], "job_type": "contract", "publication_date": "2026-10-17T16:04:29", "candidate_required_location": "Worldwide", "salary": "$1000 per task", "description": "

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

AE Studio is a ~160-person, fully bootstrapped applied AI company. We've spent over a decade building and shipping production AI for clients in finance, defense, aviation, healthcare, and education, including generating millions per week in additional revenue for a major airline and building the AI-enabled school of the future, where students are performing in the top 1% nationally. Without outside investors we are able to choose where the money goes, and we put it into alignment research through the AI Alignment Foundation, a nonprofit we founded to scale this work.

We're running a DARPA seedling on alignment and control, our policy team engages directly with the government on AI alignment, and our work has been featured many times in the Wall Street Journal. We collaborate with researchers at Anthropic, Princeton University, University College London, Redwood Research, and MATS. The research team is 25 people and growing.

About this role

We need our first in-house lawyer. Demand and our own expansion have outpaced what we can handle today: research grants closing, government and national-security work opening up, university and lab partnerships forming, and a shift toward outcome-based commercial work. All of it carries real legal weight and business urgency, and today it sits largely on the founders' shoulders, backed by excellent outside counsel.

You'd start by learning what already works here and helping scale it, then improving and adapting it as new opportunities arise. The timing is the real opportunity: we're 10 years in, established and growing fast, and right at the start of a major inflection point. You'd be here during a step change.

What you'll work on

A handful of things are happening at once, and the legal side of each is the core of the role.

  • We're shifting the commercial business toward outcome-based and productized work. That moves delivery ownership to us, meaning stronger margins and tighter focus on outcomes; you'd shape these deal terms.
  • Major research grants are coming in to fund our foundational AI Alignment work, and you'd help us win them and put them to work.
  • Government agencies, research labs, and universities are coming to us to collaborate. These partnerships are often first-of-their-kind, and you'd help shape them.
  • Our government work is expanding fast, opening a category of contracts and programs that are new ground for us and full of upside.

Intellectual property runs through all of it, and there's real opportunity in how we own, license, protect, and publish it. Underneath sit the steady in-house workstreams: NDAs and vendor agreements, employment, corporate governance, and the processes that let legal scale.

About you

We're after a strong generalist more than a specialist: solid fundamentals, judgment from real experience, and the ability to pick up new areas fast and get good at them. Day to day you'd work alongside executives, making the key calls and scaling the function.

Specifically, someone with:

  • Real business sense. You read the gap between strict interpretation and what's sensible, see where the real risk sits, and give practical guidance.
  • A negotiator who stays flexible but takes care of us, and knows which terms are worth fighting for.
  • A clear translator in both directions: turn complex business dynamics into plain strategy, and translate business goals into the right legal structure.
  • No-job-too-small instincts. A one-page NDA and a government contracting strategy are both yours, handled without ego.
  • A technical background, or deep experience with technology and technical people. You're comfortable around AI and can hold your own with engineers.
  • An AI-native way of working. You use the latest AI tools in your own legal practice to move faster and go deeper, and you do it with care for confidentiality, accuracy, and privilege.
  • Strong organizational and process skills and a systems mind, with an ownership mentality for building.
  • Creativity and the hunger to find the best answer, including approaches most lawyers wouldn't reach for.
  • A real partnership with outside counsel: when to bring them in, how to brief them, and how to get the most out of them.
  • Alignment with how we operate. We move fast, take high-variance bets, care a lot about getting things right, and own our outcomes.

Requirements

  • JD from an accredited law school, with active, good-standing membership in the California bar (open to options for exceptional out-of-state candidates).
  • Required: real strength in commercial transactions and in technology/AI work.
  • Ideal: experience across IP, nonprofit, grants, and government. You'll touch all of these here, and growing into some is fine.
  • Enough experience to have real judgment, usually substantial in-house time and/or strong firm training. We weigh judgment, adaptability, and business instinct as heavily as years or a prior GC title.
  • Complete integrity and discretion with sensitive matters.
  • Comfort in a fast, ambiguous, high-ownership environment.

Logistics

  • We are open to either full-time to start or starting on a fractional/consulting basis and convert to full-time as the work and fit develop.
  • Ideally Los Angeles; remote considered for the right person, with regular travel to HQ.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Good-faith base salary range (full-time) is $225,000 - $300,000, plus variable compensation and equity participation. If starting as an initial fractional engagement, compensation is a mutually agreed rate or retainer based on scope.
  • Remote-first with flexible schedules, health insurance, free lunches at the office, weekly knowledge-sharing talks, and an annual team retreat. Regular performance-based raises and a diversified employee equity program.

o Event loop & task queues

o Memory management

o Network layers & HTTP caching

  • Accessibility (WCAG compliance)

  • Secure RSC boundaries

  • Authentication/authorization flows

Groundwork USA seeks a Finance and Operations Manager to work side by side with the Director of Network Organizational Health in supporting Groundwork Affiliates with bookkeeping and operations. This role will serve as a point of contact for Affiliate finance and HR staff.

The Groundwork Network is a national network of people-centered, place-based organizations - Groundwork Affiliates - working to create green, thriving, and resilient neighborhoods. Collectively, we transform underutilized, contaminated land and waterways into community assets, like parks, trails, and community gardens; build community power through leadership development, organizing and collective action, and create pathways to economic opportunities through education, training, and skill-building programs that prepare community members for good jobs while simultaneously strengthening the local economy. Groundwork USA supports the success of our Network through funding, shared services and collaborative programming, and amplifies our impact by running technical assistance and peer learning communities for grassroots leaders within and beyond our Network.

The Position: The Finance and Operations Manager plays a critical role in promoting financial integrity, operational efficiency, and organizational sustainability across Groundwork Affiliates. This position is responsible for core accounting functions, grant and subaward management, financial reporting, and strengthening operational and human resources practices in collaboration with the Director of Network Organizational Health and the Network Support and Learning team. The ideal candidate brings strong nonprofit finance expertise, a collaborative mindset, and a commitment to supporting a network of mission-driven organizations.

This position is part of the Network Support and Learning (NSL) team and will report to the Director of Network Organizational Health. This is a fully remote position; candidates residing in our Affiliate cities are especially encouraged to apply. Occasional travel is required including, but not limited to, an annual staff retreat and potentially Groundwork Network gatherings.

Key Responsibilities:

Finance & Accounting

  • Manage month-end and year-end close processes, including bank reconciliations, journal entries, and account analysis

Role: Sales Manager, Other LATAM

Reports to: Regional Sales Director, LATAM

Location: Santiago, Chile preferred

Description: 

The Sales Manager will join our high-performance Global Sales and Marketing team, renowned for its excellence and success. The manager will be tasked with spearheading the sales strategies and activities for ILSC, Greystone and ELS in Chile, Argentina or Uruguay. The sales role entails orchestrating comprehensive plans to drive enrollment into our language and higher education programs. We are seeking an adept communicator with a proven track record in collaborating with agencies, schools, and universities to foster student enrollment to ILSC, ELS, Greystone College and Greystone Institute. The ideal candidate will possess a blend of charisma, ethical conduct, and a results-driven mindset, while harboring a passion for international education. The manager will be a personable and persuasive communicator, results-oriented, highly ethical, a great team player, who is seeking an opportunity to grow with a world-leading global organization in international education.

This full-time sales role offers a competitive salary package, covering 37.5 hours of work per week. However, there may be occasions when the manager will need to work additional hours per week to fulfill project deadlines and tasks, including exhibiting at fairs and/or while travelling within the region on behalf of the company. As a remote sales position, candidates should be located in Santiago, Chile or Buenos Aires, Argentina, though Chile is preferred.

Job Duties: 

The duties of this position include, but are not limited to:

  • Collaborate closely with the Regional Sales Director and sales team members to ensure the attainment of enrollment targets. This objective will be realized through increasing sales from our current agent partners and onboarding new agents with significant growth potential.
  • Support the Regional Sales Director in crafting sales projections and budgets, aiding in strategic planning for sales initiatives and resource allocation.

Drive the promotion of all ILSC Education Group brands through a multifaceted approach:

  • Presentation skills: Utilize effective presentation techniques to showcase the value propositions of ILSC Education Group to potential partners and clients.
  • Agent workshops and fairs: Participate in workshops and fairs to engage with students to increase sales.
  • Pricing strategies: Develop and implement competitive pricing strategies that resonate with the target market, ensuring optimal balance between affordability and profitability.
  • Training of agents: Provide comprehensive training programs for agents to equip them with the knowledge and skills necessary to effectively promote and sell all ILSC Education Group programs, thereby maximizing enrollment opportunities.
  • Produce group quotes.
  • Actively listen to our clients’ needs and share it with the management in a timely manner.
  • Recruit new agents and strengthen relationships with existing agents.
  • Report on agents’ performance as well as market conditions that impact enrollment numbers.
  • Participate in the development of new promotional materials in Spanish for LATAM markets.
  • Respond to general agent inquiries within one business day.
  • Travel to attend agent fairs and workshops.
  • Regularly liaise with agents to obtain student arrival information and payments, and to gather reasons for student cancellations.
  • Other duties and projects as per the direction of the Regional Sales Director.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Attributes: 

  • While not mandatory, candidates with an educational background in sales, marketing, business, communications, or related fields are preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in the international education industry.
  • Willingness and ability to travel.
  • Keen understanding of the higher educational systems in the US, Canada, Ireland and Australia.
  • Familiarity with key competitors is essential.
  • Possession of an existing network of relationships within the education industry is a valuable asset.
  • Eligibility to work in the hiring location without sponsorship.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • A self-starter who works well individually and in group settings.

Contact Information: 

While we thank all applicants, only those who are shortlisted will be contacted.

A world leader in language education & vocational training, ILSC Education Group, which opened its first language school in Vancouver, Canada in 1991 and Greystone College in 2002, offers life-changing educational experiences in Canada, Australia, Ireland and India, some of the world’s most attractive and popular English-speaking work and study destinations. Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

Role Title: Senior ML Engineer (MSc. or PhD)

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contract (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible-you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

Required Skills:

  • Machine Learning

We are looking for highly skilled Machine Learning Experts to contribute to an AI training project involving model development, training and inference systems, numerical computing, performance optimization, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating challenging machine-learning engineering tasks. A representative task may require implementing or modifying a model, constructing a reproducible training or inference workflow, optimizing memory or throughput, debugging numerical or system-level failures, and verifying that the resulting implementation satisfies objective correctness and performance requirements.

This is a very coding heavy role. Candidates but have experience using coding agents with python in their workflow.

What You’ll Work On:

  • Develop and validate machine-learning models, training pipelines, inference systems, and supporting infrastructure.

  • Implement model components, data pipelines, evaluation systems, and numerical methods.

  • Build reproducible programmatic workflows using Python and command-line tools.

Required Qualifications:

  • A master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a closely related quantitative discipline.

  • Strong professional or research experience in machine learning.

  • Practical proficiency with Python and coding agents.

Equivalent tools may also be considered when the candidate demonstrates directly relevant depth.

Experience at a well-established technology company, AI laboratory, research organization, or other recognized engineering environment is strongly preferred. Exceptional open-source or academic experience may also qualify.

Process:

  • Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.

  • Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.

  • Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure:

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability:

Typically, roles are filled within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

TaxTalente ist eine junge Job-Matching Plattform für Jobsuchende und Unternehmen in der Steuerberatung. Unser Anspruch ist es, Bewerbern in der Steuerberatung das Leben zu vereinfachen und ihnen zu ihrem Traumjob zu verhelfen. Auf Basis deiner Wünsche können wir dir deinen passenden Job, aus der Vielzahl von Top-Kanzleien in unserem deutschlandweiten Netzwerk vorschlagen und dir vollumfänglich mit unserer Expertise beratend zur Seite stehen.

Derzeit suchen wir nach einer Steuerfachkraft (Steuerfachangestellter, Steuerfachwirt oder Bilanzbuchhalter) für eine unserer Partner-Kanzleien in Reken. Falls du woanders wohnst, ist dies kein Problem, da 100% Homeoffice ebenfalls möglich ist.

Bei Rückfragen kannst du dich gerne jederzeit (auch nach deinem Feierabend) direkt telefonisch an Herrn Becker-Koch über folgende Nummer wenden: 015901431130

Aufgaben

Dein Aufgabenbereich kannst du dir auf Basis deiner persönlichen Präferenzen selbst aussuchen.

  • Erstellung von Finanzbuchhaltungen für Unternehmen unterschiedlicher Größenklassen (optional Lohnbuchhaltung)
  • Vorbereitung und Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen
  • Erstellung von betrieblichen und privaten Steuererklärungen
  • Korrespondenz mit Mandanten, Behörden und Ämtern
  • Unterstützung bei Digitalisierungsmaßnahmen
  • Weitere individuell wählbare Tätigkeitsbereiche, die deinen Interessen entsprechen

Qualifikation

Am Ende sollte es für beide Seiten passen. Deshalb wäre es gut, wenn du dich in den nachfolgenden Punkten wiederfindest.

  • Kommunikative Art und Freude am Austausch mit Mandanten
  • Sorgfältige, effiziente und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
  • Offen für eine digitale Arbeitsweise
  • Leidenschaft für steuerliche Themen

Benefits

Du hast genug von 0815 Benefits, von denen du nicht wirklich profitierst? Dann solltest du einen Blick auf die nachfolgenden Benefits werfen.

  • Außerordentliche Vergütung zwischen 52.000€ und 85.000€ / Jahr
  • Flexible Gestaltung der Arbeitszeiten sowie die Option auf 100% Homeoffice
  • Nettolohnoptimierung mit monatlichen 50,00€ Sachbezugsgutscheinen
  • Umfangreiche Unterstützung bei Fort- und Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen und ein persönlicher Mentor
  • Modernste Ausstattung mit digitalen Prozessen
  • Starker Teamzusammenhalt und regelmäßige Teamevents

Schnell, unkompliziert und effizient deinen Traumjob finden – ein Versprechen an dich, dass wir aufgrund unseres selektiven, breit gefächerten und deutschlandweiten Kanzleinetzwerks halten werden. Deine Vorteile mit uns auf einen Blick:

  • Du führst keine unsinnigen Bewerbungsgespräche mehr, bei denen du während des Bewerbungsprozesses merkst, dass es (bspw. wegen des Gehalts) sowieso nicht passt - wir klären vor deinem Bewerbungsgespräch all deine mit uns besprochenen Kriterien mit der Kanzlei ab.
  • Wir führen deine Gehaltsverhandlungen und kennen die Gehaltsstrukturen der Branche dabei bestens
  • 100% Anonymität – solange du uns nicht das „Go“ gibst und einem Kennenlernen mit deinem neuen potentiellen Arbeitgeber zustimmst, erfährt niemand von deinem Namen oder deinen bisherigen Arbeitgebern – deine dir wichtigen Kriterien können wir auch zunächst anonym mit unseren Partnerkanzleien klären
  • Attraktive Kanzleien – die Kanzleien in unserem breit gefächerten Kanzleinetzwerk sind selektiv ausgewählt und heben sich klar von “normalen” Kanzleien ab (z.B. hinsichtlich der Vergütung, Benefits, Hierarchien, Digitalisierungsgrad, Ausstattung etc.)
  • Und das Beste: Unser gesamter Service ist unverbindlich und völlig kostenfrei für dich

How You’ll Support Our Mission

We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer who brings deep technical expertise and an even deeper sense of ownership. This is not a role for someone who waits to be told what to do next. You will help architect, configure, and continuously improve the network infrastructure that underpins ESO products, and you will do it alongside a team that values candor, collaboration, and steady progress over headline-grabbing heroics.

What You’ll Be Doing - the day to day

  • Design, deploy, and maintain cloud and hybrid network infrastructure across environments.
  • Configure and manage F5 BIG-IP systems for load balancing, traffic management, and application delivery
  • Administer Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and Barracuda solutions to protect application and network layers
  • Partner with security and engineering teams to evaluate risk, enforce policy, and resolve incidents, asking the right questions early so the right solutions get built
  • Troubleshoot complex network issues methodically, communicate findings clearly, and document resolution paths that the whole team can learn from
  • Identify gaps and improvements proactively, bring forward recommendations with context, and follow through on the work
  • Support a culture of continuous improvement, not through dramatic overhauls, but through consistent, deliberate progress

What we are looking for - the essentials

  • 5 or more years of hands-on network engineering experience, with meaningful time spent in cloud environments
  • Proven experience configuring and managing F5 BIG-IP (LTM, ASM/WAF)
  • Solid working knowledge of load balancing principles and real-world application delivery
  • Experience with Azure networking, VNets, NSGs, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, or equivalent
  • Familiarity with Barracuda, SonicWall and other network appliances
  • Comfort working across firewall platforms and translating security requirements into network policy
  • A communication style that is direct, open, and respectful, you surface concerns early, share context generously, and engage in honest dialogue even when it is uncomfortable
  • A growth mindset: you measure yourself not against perfection but against where you were last quarter

How you work

At ESO, the strongest signal of a great engineer is not what they know on day one, it is how they approach learning, collaboration, and accountability over time. We are looking for someone who:

  • Asks the questions that move conversations from stuck to forward
  • Takes ownership without needing to own everything alone
  • Brings teammates along rather than working around them
  • Holds themselves to high standards and is honest when those standards are not met
  • Wants to grow, not just in technical depth, but as a teammate and contributor to something that matters

About ESO

ESO is a fast-paced, growing data, technology, and research company passionate about improving community health and safety through the power of data. We pioneer innovative, user-friendly software to meet the changing needs of today’s EMS agencies, fire departments, and hospitals. We’re small enough to be nimble and fun, but big enough to be a great place to work. We serve thousands of customers out of our offices across the US, Canada, Northern Ireland, Czech Republic, Denmark and Costa Rica.

Are you ready to Make a Difference? At ESO, we believe in bringing your true self to work every single day. If you don’t match all the qualifications on the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway! We are looking for passionate, innovative, and authentic people to help drive our mission.

All offers are contingent upon a successful background check.

ESO is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We invite you to consider opportunities at ESO regardless of your gender; gender identity; gender reassignment; age; religion; race; national origin; political affiliation; sexual orientation; disability; veteran status; or other non-merit factor.

We're looking for a Technical AEO/GEO Specialist to audit how discoverable the client's content is to AI answer engines, and to work directly with their engineering team to implement the fixes. You'll run technical audits, write implementation specs, and QA releases to make sure the work actually lands.

This is a hands-on role. You'll be doing the audits yourself and sitting with engineers through implementation, not handing off a recommendations deck and moving on. Success looks like fixes shipped and visibility improved, not findings documented.

The category is young, so expect to bring your technical SEO foundation and adapt it. Some of what works here is still being figured out.

  • QA'ing releases to confirm fixes were deployed and are working correctly.

  • Ability to write specs and tickets an engineering team can implement without hand-holding.
  • Experience working directly with client-side or partner engineering teams, including navigating their release process and priorities.
  • Comfort auditing and QA'ing your own work, and being accountable for whether a fix actually shipped.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience at an agency or platform delivering AEO or GEO as a service.
  • Background working inside a large enterprise environment where changes move through a formal engineering roadmap.
  • Familiarity with tooling for citation and visibility tracking across AI platforms.

      <title>Webflow: Senior Infrastructure Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Argentina Remote
</p>

<p>Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.</p>
<h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2>
<p>We’re looking for a <strong>S</strong><strong>enior Infrastructure Engineer </strong>to improve reliability and stability of Webflow’s customer-facing, production infrastructure, serving millions of page views per hour. Our product is used by over 2 million users world-wide across 190 countries, and you’ll help ensure our platform is secure and scalable for these users as tens of thousands of projects are launched on Webflow each month.</p>
<ul>
<li>Location: Remote-first (Argentina)</li>
<li>Permanent, full-time employee (this is not a contractor position)</li>
<li>Application Information:
<ul>
<li>Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled</li>
<li>This posting is for a new position.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p>As an <strong>Senior Infrastructure Engineer</strong> you will:</p>
<ul>
<li>Own and evolve the cloud platform that Webflow's product and engineering teams depend on, including our compute layer, EKS fleet, serverless infrastructure, networking, and cloud operations across AWS and GCP.</li>
<li>Help design and maintain our infrastructure-as-code foundation, evolving the patterns and shared components other teams build on.</li>
<li>Design and maintain the networking layer that connects Webflow's services, ensuring reliability, security, and scalability across our cloud environments.</li>
<li>Help make observability data the foundation of how we operate,&nbsp; improving the dashboards, alerts, and SLOs for the infrastructure you own so that issues are caught before customers notice, and on-call pages are actionable instead of noisy.</li>
<li>Build and maintain AI-powered automation that improves how we manage cloud infrastructure, from policy-as-code and drift detection to LLM-assisted runbook generation.</li>
<li>Help define the culture of this growing team as it expands its international presence.</li>
</ul>
<h2>About you&nbsp;</h2>
<p>You’ll thrive as a <strong>Senior Infrastructure Engineer</strong>&nbsp;if you:</p>
<ul>
<li>Have a background as an infrastructure, site reliability engineer or cloud engineer with an enthusiasm for automation and code, or a background as a software engineer with deep enthusiasm for cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Have 5+ years of experience owning and operating cloud infrastructure in a customer-facing environment that allows for little to no downtime.</li>
<li>Have deep hands-on experience with AWS and a strong opinion on what good cloud operations look like.</li>
<li>Have experience managing Kubernetes clusters at scale, including upgrades, node group management, autoscaling, and cluster add-on lifecycle.</li>
<li>Have experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Pulumi or Terraform, and a strong preference for changes made through code, not consoles.</li>
<li>Have experience navigating multi-region or multi-cloud environments on AWS or GCP.</li>
<li>Stay curious and open to growth, demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.</li>
</ul>
<p>It would be a bonus if you had even one of the following:</p>
<ul>
<li>Experience with Karpenter, cluster autoscaler, or other Kubernetes-native scaling tooling.</li>
<li>Have experience with OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus or Grafana</li>
<li>Experience building AI-assisted infrastructure tooling, including cost optimization loops, anomaly detection, or policy-as-code with LLM assistance.</li>
<li>Experience contributing to multi-region architecture including data residency, regional failover, or latency-based routing.</li>
</ul>
<p>You Are:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Collaborative</strong>: You possess a collaborative spirit, thriving when working with both your immediate team and cross-functional partners.</li>
<li><strong>Strategic thinker</strong>: You're a strategic thinker, adept at defining clear business needs and evaluating solutions to make informed build-versus-buy decisions.</li>
<li><strong>Comfortable with ambiguity</strong>: You navigate ambiguous situations with ease, gathering data and making progress even with incomplete information or unclear requirements.</li>
</ul>
<p>If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still <strong>seriously consider applying</strong>. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.</p>
<h3><strong>Our Core Behaviors:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Build lasting customer trust.</strong> We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.</li>
<li><strong>Win together.</strong> We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.</li>
<li><strong>Reinvent ourselves. </strong>We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.</li>
<li><strong>Own it all the way. </strong>We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Ownership in what you help build.</strong> Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.</li>
<li><strong>Health coverage that actually covers you.</strong> Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.</li>
<li><strong>Support for every stage of family life</strong>. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.</li>
<li><strong>Time off that’s actually off. </strong>Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.</li>
<li><strong>Wellness for the whole you. </strong>Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.</li>
<li><strong>Invest in your future. </strong>A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Monthly stipends that flex with your life.</strong> Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.</li>
<li><strong>Bonus for building together. </strong>All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.</em></p>
<h3><strong>Remote, together</strong></h3>
<p>At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are <a href="https://webflow.com/diversity-equity-inclusion">committed</a> to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.</p>
<h3><strong>Stay connected</strong></h3>
<p>Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our <a href="https://webflow.com/blog">Webflow Blog</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/webflow-inc-/">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/webflow">X (Twitter)</a>, and/or <a href="https://www.glassdoor.com/Reviews/Webflow-Reviews-E890506.htm">Glassdoor</a>.&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>Please note:</strong></h3>
<p><em>We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for confidential accommodation requests will be administered.</em></p>
<p><em>To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment.</em></p>
<p><em>If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes.</em></p>
<p><em>For information about how Webflow processes your personal information, please review </em><a href="https://webflow.com/legal/applicant-privacy-notice"><em>Webflow’s Applicant Privacy Notice</em></a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/webflow-senior-infrastructure-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/webflow-senior-infrastructure-engineer</a></p>

      <title>Wrike: Director, Global GTM Strategy & Operations</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> US - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div>Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><strong>Our vision:&nbsp; </strong>A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div></div><h3>About the Role:</h3>
<p>You'll own your outcomes, from the strategies you run to the conversations that shape what we build next. Collaborative work management is a $14B category growing at 15% a year, and the enterprise competitive set is consolidating fast. Wrike is hiring a Director of Go-To-Market Operations to lead our global GTM Operations team across Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing.</p>
<p>You will own Wrike’s revenue planning and operational architecture end-to-end driving annual planning, quota setting, territory management, and cross-functional alignment across our global revenue engine.</p>
<p>Reporting directly to GTM leadership, you will serve as a strategic co-pilot to executive leaders while leading a hands-on global team of 6–15 operations partners and analysts.</p>
<p>This is an action-oriented leadership role for an operational "athlete'' - someone equally comfortable steering C-level strategic decisions, designing enterprise sales workflows, coaching an international team across time zones, and diving deep into the details of compensation plans or GTM forecasting.</p>
<h3>Your Impact:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Global Team Leadership: Build, scale, and mentor a global GTM Operations team (15 team members, including embedded business partners and visualization analysts across diverse time zones), fostering a high-performance, team-first culture.</li>
<li>Annual Planning &amp; Execution: Lead annual planning, quota allocation, capacity modeling, and territory design across Sales, CS, and Marketing teams.</li>
<li>Retention &amp; Growth PMO: Partner with executive leadership to program manage company-wide objectives focused on gross/net retention, bookings, and customer lifecycle optimization.</li>
<li>Executive Facilitation: Lead recurring operational cadences with executive stakeholders (Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance, Legal) to eliminate friction and accelerate deal velocity.</li>
<li>Commercial Support &amp; Governance: Oversee non-customer-facing commercial execution, coordinating with Legal, Finance, and Deal Desk to streamline order processing and contracting workflows.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Your Qualifications:</h3>
<ul>
<li>8+ years of progressive experience in Business Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Operations within B2B SaaS.</li>
<li>Proven People Leadership: Direct experience managing and developing global operational teams (6+ direct/indirect reports) across international time zones.</li>
<li>Core GTM Mechanics: Expertise in SaaS unit economics, quota setting, territory planning, retention/bookings metrics, and annual planning processes.</li>
<li>Execution Track Record: High proficiency operating as an executive-level partner to Sales, Marketing, and CS leadership without needing a massive administrative layer.</li>
<li>Location Preference: East Coast U.S. preferred (ability to align with global time zones and executive leadership).</li>
</ul>
<h3>Standout Qualities:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Core Traits: High curiosity (constantly seeking better ways to execute), unyielding commitment to follow-through, and rigorous attention to detail.</li>
<li>Sales Methodology: Familiarity with enterprise value selling frameworks (e.g., Force Management's Command of the Message, MEDDPICC, or Challenger).</li>
<li>Target Background: Experience operating in high-growth, execution-oriented B2B SaaS environments</li>
</ul>
<p>Team Dynamics: You will partner closely with executive leadership and lead a global team of GTM business partners and data visualization specialists. Your team acts as the central nerve center connecting field execution with executive strategy.</p>
<p>Our Work Style: We run Wrike on Wrike. You will use our collaborative work management platform daily to run annual planning, manage operational portfolios, and track team execution. We value intellectual curiosity, data-backed decision-making, and swift cross-functional execution.</p>
<h3><strong>Benefits &amp; Perks:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Flexible Time Off (FTO)</li>
<li>Company 401(k) Match</li>
<li>Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity&nbsp;</li>
<li>2 Volunteer Days</li>
<li>Health (medical, dental &amp; vision) Insurance (EEs + Dependents)</li>
<li>Disability (STD, LTD) &amp; Life Insurance Plans (2x Salary, Capped)</li>
<li>Working from Home Allowance ($40 / Monthly)</li>
<li>$500 Working from Home home office set-up Stipend</li>
</ul>

<div>We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.</div>

<div>

<div>Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.</div>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote from the US
</p>

<h2>Who we are</h2>
<h3>About Stripe</h3>
<p><span>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p>
<h3>About the team</h3>
<p>Abuse Research Group (ARG) handles proactive threat hunting and adversary behavior analysis across Stripe products. Rather than reacting to alerts, the team maps end-to-end fraud and abuse paths, validates novel attack vectors, and identifies product conditions that enable fraud. Using agentic automated testing and simulation tools, ARG translates research into actionable threat advisories, strategic control recommendations, and regression scenarios to systematically eliminate vulnerabilities.</p>
<h2>What you’ll do</h2>
<p>As an Abuse Research Engineer in the Abuse Research Group, you will play a critical role in safeguarding Stripe’s financial ecosystem by proactively hunting for advanced threats, dissecting complex fraud vectors, and extracting actionable adversary intelligence. &nbsp;Rather than relying solely on reactive alerts, you will develop and execute hypothesis-driven threat hunting operations across internal telemetry and external sources to uncover fraudulent tools, tactics, and techniques (TTPs) before they impact Stripe’s platform. Central to this work is FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0), Stripe’s multi-layered taxonomy that decomposes monolithic fraud into structured kill chains. &nbsp;Collaborating cross-functionally with Fraud Ops, Strategy, Risk, Onboarding, and Security, you will integrate threat intelligence, build agentic simulation workflows, and systematically eliminate product vulnerabilities.</p>
<h3>Responsibilities</h3>
<ul>
<li>Proactive Threat Hunting &amp; Kill Chain Analysis: Formulate hypotheses and conduct iterative threat hunting operations across Stripe systems and external data.</li>
<li>FT3 Taxonomy: Apply and enrich the FT3 framework across empirical datasets and incidents, standardizing threat intelligence across kill chain phases and targeted API endpoints. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Threat Intelligence &amp; Signal Expansion: Partner with teams like Fraud Intelligence to integrate, curate, and automate threat feeds into engineering workflows. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Cross-Functional Advisories &amp; Strategic Controls: Translate raw research and retrospective findings into actionable threat advisories and control recommendations (policy, technical systems, support workflows, and detection mechanisms) for stakeholders across Fraud, Risk, Onboarding, and Security. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Agentic Testing &amp; Adversary Simulation: Utilize agentic automated testing frameworks to simulate adversary TTPs, validate whether deployed controls interrupt empirical kill chains, and generate regression scenarios to exercise controls. &nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2>
<p><span>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p>
<h3>Minimum requirements</h3>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience conducting threat intelligence, threat hunting, or technical incident response within cyber security, product abuse, or trust domains.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>5+ years of experience analyzing large, complex datasets using data analytics tools to identify anomalies, map behavioral trends, and solve complex fraud problems.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with demonstrated experience using code and scripting to automate workflows, build investigative tools, or query big data pipelines.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Hands-on experience in log analysis (e.g., application logs, API route telemetry, network security events), digital forensics, and cyber investigation methodologies.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Strong communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical research into clear, actionable recommendations and advisories for cross-functional partners.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Deep technical understanding of threat actor motivations, infrastructure, and TTPs specific to financial fraud (e.g., ATO, Card Testing, Credential Stuffing).&nbsp;</li>
<li>Familiarity with standardized taxonomies such as FT3 or MITRE ATT&amp;CK.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Proficiency with engineering, data processing, and analysis platforms such as Databricks, Trino, PySpark, Pandas, or Scikit-Learn.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Proven background utilizing Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIPs), tactical threat feeds, OSINT, and breach intelligence.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Demonstrated capability building or leveraging agentic LLM tools, automated testing systems, or control validation frameworks to model adversary behavior at scale.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Participation in industry conferences, webinars, or threat-sharing groups, alongside relevant professional certifications (e.g., GCTI, GCFA, OSCP).</li>
</ul>

<p><em>The general salary range for this full-time position is $80,000 – 115,000. Salary offers will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, skills, training and education.</em></p>
<p><em>&nbsp;</em></p>
<p>Humane World for Animals, a global leader in animal advocacy and protection, is seeking a Web Developer, eCRM to support Digital Marketing and other departments by providing front-end, global web development solutions for fundraising, advocacy engagement, and other strategic priorities — incorporating AI-assisted and agentic development tools to accelerate delivery while maintaining rigorous human oversight, quality, and security standards.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p>

<li>Collaborates regularly with Digital Marketing, Brand and Visuals, and IS teams to discuss project requirements and makes technical recommendations. Writes efficient code and maintains custom donation forms, advocacy forms, other webpages, and email templates. Incorporates best practices for user experience, accessibility, page speed optimization, and GDPR compliance implementation. Adheres to global regulations and standards, regional data compliance, and security compliance;</li>
<li>Uses AI-assisted development tools and agentic coding assistants to accelerate coding, refactoring, debugging, testing, and documentation. Proactively identifies opportunities for AI-assisted and agent-built solutions and owns the ongoing maintenance, monitors their performance over time and updates or retires them as needed. Follows established guardrails and usage standards for AI tools and applies human-in-the-loop review to all AI-generated code and configurations, validating output for accuracy, security, accessibility, and brand/technical standards before deployment;</li>
<li>Follows quality assurance procedures and troubleshoots technical issues affecting donation forms, advocacy forms, webpages, and email templates in Engaging Networks. Works closely with vendor partners;</li>
<li>Works with the Information Security team to ensure that digital properties meet security standards, including managing script inventory, attestation, and other requirements for PCI compliance;</li>
<li>Collaborates with the testing team to gather testing requirements and implement new features to run A/B and multivariate tests on forms;</li>
<li>Creates and maintains clear and concise documentation of custom web development, support guides, and incident reports;</li>
<li>Performs other duties as assigned.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Qualifications and Requirements:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor's degree in computer programming, web development, or related field, or equivalent work experience required;&nbsp;</li>
<li>A minimum of four (4) years of experience in front-end web development and developing custom websites required;</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience with Engaging Networks or other eCRMs;</li>
<li>Proficient in HTML5, Sass and CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, GitHub, Engaging Networks modules, Webpack, Node, npm, core AWS services, and Mailgun. Familiar with Segment or other CDPs;</li>
<li>Direct experience with AI coding assistants and agentic development tools such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot;</li>
<li>Knowledge of best practices for responsive, mobile-first web design, UX, accessibility, page speed optimization, browser support, and GDPR compliance;</li>
<li>Familiar with cookie consent tools, preferably Iubenda, for configuring compliance settings;</li>
<li>Experience building interactive data visualizations that translate campaigns into compelling stories for supporters to increase engagement;</li>
<li>Excellent attention to detail when coding projects based on Adobe XD files or Figma;</li>
<li>Understanding of digital marketing strategies for US and international audiences;</li>
<li>Stays on top of AI trends in web development, including personalization and workflow automation, and their responsible application to fundraising and advocacy technology;</li>
<li>Strong written and verbal communication skills;</li>
<li>Must be able to multi-task in a fast-paced, collaborative environment to deliver high quality work on deadline. Familiarity with Jira and Confluence a plus;</li>
<li>Data informed problem solver having experience with A/B testing platforms and Google Analytics;</li>
<li>Proactive and ability to work both independently and as an effective team member in a team environment;</li>
<li>Interest in animal protection issues preferred.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>This is a full-time remote position based in the United States.&nbsp;Candidates must be able to accomodate Eastern Time hours, as needed.&nbsp;</strong></p>

<p>Q<em>ualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, and disability, marital or parental status or protected veteran status.&nbsp; EOE</em>&nbsp;</p>

      <title>Doximity: Commercial Data Scientist</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.)
</p>

<h3><strong>Commercial Data Scientist</strong></h3>
<p>Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.&nbsp;</p>
<p>At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.</p>
<p><br><em>This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S.</em></p>
<p><strong>As a Commercial Data Scientist</strong>, you’ll work within cross-functional delivery teams alongside other analysts, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in discovering data insights to help improve healthcare.</p>
<p><strong>How you’ll make an impact:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Deliver novel and impactful insights for client organizations using machine learning and AI technologies.</li>
<li>Work closely with our Product, Platform Data, Insights &amp; Strategy, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses.</li>
<li>Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates and future projects.</li>
<li>Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform.</li>
<li>Embrace the challenge of a fast-paced environment to exceed client expectations</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team</strong></p>
<p><strong>As an organization we value diversity - </strong>in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Collaboration</strong>—The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.</li>
<li><strong>Passion for Data</strong>—You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights.</li>
<li><strong>Reliability</strong> – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success.</li>
<li><strong>Curiosity</strong> – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight.</li>
<li><strong>Respect</strong> – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>About you:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>At least <strong>4 years</strong> of professional experience as a Data Scientist or other related roles working with complex, high-volume, structured and unstructured datasets.</li>
<li>Prior experience in a data science consulting role at firms such as ZS, Trinity, IQVIA, BlueMatter, etc., where you thrived in a fast-paced environment</li>
<li>Advanced knowledge of statistical concepts — particularly exploratory data analysis, experimental design, and probability theory.</li>
<li>Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques</li>
<li>Proven ability to design, train, and evaluate large-scale production models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.</li>
<li>Advanced SQL proficiency — skilled at writing and optimizing complex queries across multiple tables and data relationships.</li>
<li>Advanced Python skills, including understanding of object-oriented programming, production-grade code design, and modern data science libraries.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with distributed data processing tools and concepts for scalable analysis and model training.</li>
<li>Excellent data visualization and storytelling abilities, with the capacity to translate technical insights into clear, compelling narratives for internal and client stakeholders.</li>
<li>Curious, fast learner with a demonstrated passion for data, continuous learning, and staying current with advances in machine learning research.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Fun</strong> <strong>Facts About the Client Intelligence team</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections.</li>
<li>Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights.</li>
<li>The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds.</li>
<li>We like to have fun - company outings, team lunches, and other social events!</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Compensation</strong></p>
<p>The anticipated total compensation for this role is $119,333 - $172,800 depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.</p>
<p>Our total compensation package may include:</p>
<ul>
<li>Base salary</li>
<li>Equity (where applicable)</li>
<li>Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable)</li>
</ul>
<p>Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Benefits</strong></p>
<p>In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:</p>
<ul>
<li>Medical, dental, and vision insurance</li>
<li>401(k) with company match</li>
<li>Flexible paid time off and company holidays</li>
<li>Paid parental leave</li>
<li>Professional development and learning opportunities</li>
<li>Wellness and mental health resources</li>
<li>Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable)</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Why You'll Love Working Here</strong></p>
<p>At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Make a real impact.</strong> Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.</li>
<li><strong>Work with exceptional teammates.</strong> Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.</li>
<li><strong>Enjoy flexibility and trust.</strong> We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.</li>
<li><strong>Grow your career.</strong> Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.</li>
<li><strong>Bring your authentic self.</strong> We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Our Hiring Process &amp; AI Tools</strong></p>
<p>Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity</strong></p>
<p><em>Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.</em></p>
<p><em>If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation.</em></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/doximity-commercial-data-scientist">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/doximity-commercial-data-scientist</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Hex Technologies: Legal Ops</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> NYC or Remote (EST or CST)
</p>

<p><strong>About the role:</strong></p>
<p>Hex’s legal function has gone from zero to a fully operating system in under a year. Now we need someone to own and scale the operating layer so it holds as the company grows. <strong>This is a builder role.</strong></p>
<p>You’ll run contract operations end to end: CLM administration, workflow optimization, template and playbook maintenance, enablement and training for the revenue team, and first-pass review and redlining of standard agreements against our playbook. Beyond contracts, you’ll build structured intake for every legal workstream across the company, own the legal governance record (privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars), manage outside counsel relationships, and own the legal tech stack. We sit at the nexus of data, AI, and collaboration, which means our legal operations have to be as thoughtful as our product.</p>
<p>We use AI tooling across legal operations, and you’ll work the same way: building agents and automations to move faster, not as a side project but as the default way things get done here. If you see a manual workflow and instinctively want to build it away, you’ll feel right at home.</p>
<p><strong>What you will do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Drive CLM adoption and enablement so the revenue team self-serves on standard deals</li>
<li>Own workflow optimization, templates, and playbooks as deal structures and products evolve</li>
<li>First-pass review and redlining of standard agreements; draft from templates as volume requires</li>
<li>Build and own structured intake for legal workstreams across the company</li>
<li>Build AI-powered workflows, agents, and automations that replace manual processes</li>
<li>Maintain the legal governance record: privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars</li>
<li>Train cross-functional teams on self-service tools and escalation paths</li>
<li>Manage outside counsel relationships and the legal tech stack</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>About You:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>3-5+ years in legal operations, paralegal, or contract management, with at least 1-2 years in-house at a tech or SaaS company</li>
<li>You’ve implemented or rebuilt a CLM (Ironclad preferred), designed intake workflows, and stood up reporting someone relied on</li>
<li>Experience reviewing and redlining commercial agreements on both sell-side and buy-side paper</li>
<li>You build with AI and automation as a natural part of how you work. You’re comfortable across AI-assisted legal tools, LLMs, and automation platforms, and willing to experiment with new ones as they emerge. This isn’t a nice-to-have at Hex.</li>
<li>Comfortable operating with autonomy in a role with a lot of white space</li>
<li>Good judgment about what you can handle and what needs a lawyer</li>
<li>You care whether people actually use what you build</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Nice to have:</em></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a company navigating exponential growth</li>
<li>Experience with corporate governance (entity management, board materials, annual filings)</li>
<li>Has used Hex</li>
<li>Strong opinions about the best way to organize a Notion workspace</li>
</ul>
<p>We know job posts like this can feel like a checklist, and nobody checks every box. If you’ve built legal ops infrastructure, you’re excited about AI, and this role sounds like the kind of work you want to do, we’d love to hear from you.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<p>In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary &amp; equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.</p>
<p>The salary range for this role is: $124,125 - $165,500.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness &amp; parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process.</p>
<p>By submitting an application the candidate consents to the use of their personal information in accordance with the Hex Privacy policy:&nbsp;<span class="link-annotation-unknown-block-id-754370997"><a href="https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy">https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy</a></span>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Hex Technologies uses AI-assisted tools as part of our application review process, including for resume screening and fraud detection. These tools help our <strong>team </strong>evaluate applications and verify applicant information. All AI-generated recommendations are reviewed by a member of our recruiting team before any hiring decision is made. No application is automatically rejected based solely on an AI tool's output.</p></div>
